parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lp_campaign_id: $json.lp_campaign_id, name: $json.name, public_name: $json.public_name, vertical: $json.vertical, status: $json.status, updated_at: $json.updated_at }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ run_id: $json.run_id, lp_campaign_id: $json.lp_campaign_id, status: 'running', date_from: $json.date_from, date_to: $json.date_to }) }}

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const s = $json; const p = ['campaign=' + encodeURIComponent(s.lp_campaign_id), 'start_date=' + encodeURIComponent(s.date_from), 'end_date=' + encodeURIComponent(s.date_to), 'timezone=UTC']; if (s.search_after) p.push('search_after=' + encodeURIComponent(s.search_after)); return 'https://api.leadprosper.io/public/leads?' + p.join('&'); })() }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), leads_fetched: $json.total_fetched, leads_inserted: $json.total_inserted }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ last_synced_at: new Date().toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', finished_at: new Date().toISOString(), error_message: $json.error_message }) }}
